services.name: Sunset Harbor Sail
services.desc: The Sunset Sail offers extraordinary views of the historic city of Charleston from the water Join us as we end the day with warm sea breezes that mingle with incredible pastel colored skies on our hour and 45 minute public Sunset Sail. Our most premier sail time of the day, the Sunset Sail offers extraordinary views of the historic city of Charleston from the water, with the warm, glowing sun setting peacefully in the distance. We often get up-close views of Atlantic Bottlenose dolphin and other marine wildlife while sailing by many of the incredible sites found in historic Charleston Harbor. And as always, our trips are BYOB so feel free to bring a bottle of wine or whatever you would like

services.name: Private Daysail on Prevailing Winds
services.desc: Come enjoy a beautiful private sail and discover Charleston from the water! Rates Private Charter for 2 - $275 Private Charter for 3-6 - +$25/person Extra Hours - $120 6 People Max Duration 1 Hour 30 Minutes About The Prevailing Winds is our 27 foot Stiletto catamaran. Built for speed, she can zip around the harbor while comfortably holding up to 6 passengers. Feel free to bring along something to eat and/or drink while you sit back and enjoy the rush of water beneath you. The Prevailing Winds has cushioned bench seating in the cockpit or the more adventurous might like to lay out on the tramp (the net) up forward. Give us a call if you would like to extend your charter! What to Bring

checkin: When to Meet We recommend arriving 20 minutes prior to your trip's departure. Unfortunately, there is no public parking at the Charleston Maritime Center. We suggest parking at the Aquarium Garage (which is about a block away) or at a parking meter on Concord Street. Parking meters are free after 6:00pm and all day on Sundays.
cancellation: Any cancellations or changes to your reservation must be made by phone and should be made at least 14 days prior to your charter to receive a refund. Cancellations can be made online through a link in your confirmation email or over the phone. Within 14 days and you will be eligible for a 50% refund. There are no refunds or reschedules within 72 hours of your charter.
